page_title: BRE 0-2 MON | Brest v Monaco 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Bilal Brahimi (Brest) serves up a nice cross, but Radoslaw Majecki punches the ball away.
90+4' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+4' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is shown a red card and his teammates aren't happy! He must leave the pitch.
90+2' Eric Roy is stunned as referee Ruddy Buquet shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+1' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+1' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The total number of attempts is 11:8.
88' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.

87' Martin Satriano (Brest) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Radoslaw Majecki keeps the ball out.
87' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Brest out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
86' Bilal Brahimi (Brest) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romain Del Castillo.
85' Mahdi Camara (Brest) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
85' Substitution. Folarin Balogun did his best and is replaced by Breel Embolo (Monaco).
84' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
84' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
82' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
79' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mohamed Camara (Monaco) replacing Denis Zakaria.
78' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Jonas Martin will be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
78' That will be all from Maghnes Akliouche who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
78' A player from Brest commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
76' 7:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
73' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
71' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
69' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Kenny Lala (Brest) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
68' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
65' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
63' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Good work from Brest as they win a corner.
62' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Kamory Doumbia is replaced by Mahdi Camara (Brest).
62' It is time for a substitution. Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is on for Steve Mounie.
60' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) steps up and sends a mid-range free kick well wide of the right post. Strong but inaccurate shot.
59' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) takes the direct free kick from a distance of 24.9 metres.
59' The whistle blows and Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) is booked for an infringement.
56' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:6.
55' Brest take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.

52' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
49' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Ruddy Buquet signals that the goal stands! The Monaco players celebrate.
49' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Ruddy Buquet is going to take a look using VAR.
48' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) was set free in the area by Krepin Diatta and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:2.

47' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Ruddy Buquet has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Brest have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Ruddy Buquet shows a yellow card to Denis Zakaria (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
42' Ruddy Buquet sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
41' The Monaco players halt their celebrations as referee Ruddy Buquet makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

40' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Denis Zakaria (Monaco) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Marco Bizot, so the score changes to 0:1.
38' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 54:46.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
34' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Monaco win a free kick.
33' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for an infringement.
30' 3:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
28' It's a nice effort by Hugo Magnetti (Brest) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Radoslaw Majecki. Easy save.
25' One of the players from Monaco times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
24' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
23' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
23' It looks like Kenny Lala (Brest) saw red with that tackle. Ruddy Buquet won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
20' PENALTY APPEAL by Brest, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
19' Martin Satriano (Brest) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just wide of the left post.
19' The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
18' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
18' Martin Satriano (Brest) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Brest will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and it's Folarin Balogun (Monaco) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
14' Steve Mounie (Brest) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Martin Satriano (Brest) plays a through ball but overhits it.
7' The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
7' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Bizot, who smothers the ball.
3' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
1' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
